# Project Alpha Progress Report

Project Alpha (PA) builds a processing chain for rover images. After a one-year extension, Project Alpha now runs from 2024 to 2027 and is coordinated by the Alpha Imaging Lab.

## Work Packages

Project Alpha WP1 (Data Ingestion) is complete; the ingestion tool D1 was delivered in month 7, one month late.

Project Alpha WP2 (Data Processing) has grown to 52 person-months. The mosaic pipeline D2 is now due in month 24.

Project Alpha WP3 (Visualisation) started in month 14. The public viewer D3 has a first prototype.

## Project Management

The steering board of Project Alpha now meets every two months. The project manager reports progress to the funding agency every quarter.
